arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ وَالتّينِ وَالزَّيتونِ
translation: By the fig and the olive
And by this land made safe

arabic: لَقَد خَلَقنَا الإِنسٰنَ فى أَحسَنِ تَقويمٍ
transliteration: Laqad khalaqna alinsana fee ahsani taqweemin
translation: Surely We created man of the best stature
Then we reduced him to the lowest of the low

arabic: إِلَّا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَلَهُم أَجرٌ غَيرُ مَمنونٍ
transliteration: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati falahum ajrun ghayru mamnoonin
translation: Save those who believe and do good works, and theirs is a reward unfailing
So who henceforth will give the lie to thee about the judgment
Is not Allah the most conclusive of all judges
